statement: Let g : Y → X be a surjective morphism with Y connected smooth projective. Assume: (i) g∗ D = 2E for an effective integral divisor E on Y ; (ii) over a nonempty Zariski open B ⊂ X \ D, the map g is smooth with connected fibres F, and Ω1 F is trivial; (iii) above a general point of each prime divisor P ̸= D of X, there is a point at which g is a submersion; (iv) above a general point of D, there is a point at which a local lift to the root chart is a submersion. If X is special, then Y is special. There is also a surjection (3.1) π1(Y ) ↠ π1(X \ D)/⟨⟨γ2 ⟩⟩. Consequently Assumption 1.2 implies virtual abelianity of the group on the right.
